displayName: Citrus API: /api/health scheduledTrigger not ok (edge uptime check)

documentation.content:
**What it means.** `https://citrusfantasysports.com/api/health` is answering without `checks.scheduledTrigger == "ok"`, or not answering. Without `SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_SECRET` the `/api/scheduled/*` router refuses every request: daily roster lock, waiver processing, trade-review sweep, matchup sweep and news ingest all stop, and the GitHub Actions jobs that call them go red.

**What to do.**
1. `curl -s https://citrusfantasysports.com/api/health | jq .checks`
2. `unconfigured` -> `gcloud run services update citrus-api --region=northamerica-northeast1 --project=citrus-fantasy-prod --update-secrets=SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_SECRET=scheduled-trigger-secret:latest`
3. Confirm the next scheduled run: GitHub -> Actions -> daily-waiver-process -> Run workflow, then the Cloud Run request log should show `northamerica-northeast1 200 .../api/scheduled/waiver-process`.

Managed by `infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-uptime.sh` (`alert-uptime-api-scheduled-trigger.json`).
